# Script bodies the pipefail grep -q scanner must pass, one per block; a line
# holding only %% ends a block.
grep -q -- "^--- PASS: TestX " <<<"$out"
%%
n="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c PASS)"
%%
check || grep -q x file
%%
# a comment naming cmd | grep -q x
%%
echo 'quoted | grep -q x'
%%
grep -q x <<<"$(cmd | sort)"
%%
cmd | grep -v x | wc -l
%%
grep -qE 'a|b' file
%%
kc get pods |
	grep -v Running
%%
head -c 100 < big > small
%%
head -n 1 file
%%
out="$(gen)"; head -n 1 <<<"$out"; grep -m1 pat <<<"$out"; grep -l pat file
